items.statement: In six pilot practices over four months, at least 90 percent of overrides for accepted exceptions are completed within one working day, and the safety review finds no held request that delayed a clinically important decision.
items.rationale: These are the two conditions the network committee and the laboratory need before rollout; planning values come from c2 and c3.
items.risks: Too few overrides to estimate timeliness precisely; rare harm undetectable in four months.

items.statement: At least 60 percent of requesters rate the comment as clear and acceptable.
The rule fires more often in high-repeat practices without a higher override rate.
items.risks: Six practices are too few for comparison; descriptive only.

summary: Three feasibility propositions; h1 carries the progression decision.
